personality_one_liner: A high-performance, command-center interface for real-time travel tracking, blending OLED-friendly darkness with sharp neon green data accents.

spacing.rule: Dense, tactical spacing for high data visibility. Avoid excess empty space; prioritize alignment and structural dividers.

do's: Use solid dark surfaces or brandTertiary tints for elevation.
Use dividers to separate list items on high-density data screens.
dont's: No blur on heavy data panels.
Do not use heavy shadows; rely on border and surface tone.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Command center dashboard providing immediate access to all 7 core railway tracking features.
screens.layout: Screen root uses 'surface'. Top 1/3 is a hero banner (using hero_bg image) with a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Large Rajdhani greeting text. Below the hero, use a multi-column grid (`flexDirection: 'row'`, `flexWrap: 'wrap'`, `justifyContent: 'space-between'`, `gap: md`) for 6 feature tiles (Train Search, PNR, Live Status, Seat Availability, Fare, Route). The tiles use `surfaceSecondary` with `brandTertiary` icon containers. Fixed FAB at bottom right for 'ODAYA Assistant' using `brandPrimary` pill.

screens.name: Train Search
screens.purpose: Form to find trains between stations with real-time-like result cards.

states.empty: Illustration/icon + 'No trains found on this route'.

screens.layout: Sticky top form with From, To, and Date inputs. Sticky 'Search' CTA. Results scroll below as stacked cards on `surfaceSecondary`. Each card highlights Train Number (displayFontFamily), Name, Departs/Arrives time, and Duration. Divider between list items.

screens.name: PNR Status

states.empty: Empty state prompting to enter 10-digit PNR.

screens.layout: Large 10-digit input field at the top. Below, a robust details card showing Passenger info (Name/Age/Gender), Coach/Seat numbers in heavy typography, and Status (CNF in success color, WL in warning color).

screens.name: Live Train Status
screens.purpose: Real-time tracking of train location and delays.
screens.layout: High-impact layout. Large active metrics. Current Station in `2xl` font, Next Station below it. A bold indicator block for 'Delay: XX mins' (uses warning or success color). Segmented control for timeline vs live map. Strict, operational aesthetic with dividers.

screens.name: Seat Availability
screens.purpose: Check quota and seat availability across travel classes.
screens.layout: Date/Train selector sticky at top. Horizontal scroll for Classes (1A, 2A, 3A, SL, CC). Below that, a list of availability for the upcoming days. Tags using `brandTertiary` for AVAILABLE, `surfaceTertiary` for WL.

screens.name: Fare Calculator
screens.layout: Input params (Source, Dest, Class). Results shown as a structured receipt/invoice layout. Base Fare, GST, Superfast charges aligned right. Total Fare oversized at the bottom.

screens.name: Train Route
screens.layout: Vertical timeline. Left side has a persistent track line with node dots. Passed stations are greyed out (`muted`), current station is `brandPrimary`, upcoming are `surfaceInverse`. Right side holds station name, arrival, and halt time.

screens.name: ODAYA Assistant
screens.purpose: Conversational AI agent for travel queries powered by Groq.

states.empty: Welcome message with suggested query chips.
states.error: Failed to send message + Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Chat interface. Background uses a very subtle tint or abstract dark bg. User bubbles are `surfaceTertiary`. Bot bubbles have a subtle `brandPrimary` left-border and `brandTertiary` background. Input field fixed at bottom within `KeyboardAvoidingView`.

hero_bg.alt: High speed train passing illuminated buildings at night

assistant_bg.alt: Abstract neon green geometric lines on a black background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the user's request for a bright green and black theme. Implement the Dark-First Utility (7) personality.
Do NOT use any blue, purple, or indigo colors across the UI. Stick exclusively to the defined black/grey surfaces and neon green brand colors.

Populate the demo data with Indian Railways contextual information (e.g., Rajdhani Express, Shatabdi, New Delhi, Mumbai Central). Clearly label the screens as containing 'demo/sample data' in the headers or footers.
On the Home Screen, utilize a gradient scrim (`transparent` to `surface` ~80%) over the hero_bg image to ensure text readability.
Implement the ODAYA Assistant screen with a standard chat UI, differentiating user bubbles and bot bubbles clearly through color tokens (bot bubble gets the brand tint).
Use fixed primary CTAs at the bottom of forms (like Train Search and Fare Calculator) utilizing `KeyboardAvoidingView`.
